name: Header Junk Remover
author: Joseph Brzezowski

sections.description:
Header Junk Remover is a simple plugin to clean up your site’s section:

  • Removes unnecessary tags (RSD, XMLRPC, WLW, WordPress version, etc.)
  • Eliminates extra RSS feed links
  • Speeds up page load times by reducing overhead
  • Easy to install and use—no configuration needed

Requirements

WordPress 6.0.0 or greater

Credits

Made with care by Joseph Brzezowski,
Founder of AvocadoWeb Services LLC.

License

GPL v3 or later.
See LICENSE.txt for full details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the junk-header-remover folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Once activated, it works automatically—no settings required.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything?

No, the plugin works automatically upon activation.

Will this break my website?

No, the plugin only removes unnecessary tags that do not affect core functionality.
